text:
Sara: Heads-up — after the 17:02 infra deploy our paging integration started suppressing pages for the primary rotation. Noticing gaps and some duplicates to the secondary oncall.
Ben: ugh, seeing alerts stuck in notify-queue with status=SUPPRESSED. Any recent changes to notify schema?
Sara: Yep, infra rolled a tiny change to notification payloads. I can paste logs.
Max: can someone @Eli? primary oncall might be missing pages.
Eli: I'm on it. I saw one manual page at 17:10, didn't get the first auto page.
Lucy: Customer support getting multiple callbacks saying they were paged twice by different numbers.
Ben: log excerpt:
```
INFO 2026-03-17T17:03:12Z notify-service deliver attempt id=gh-12345 payload={"escalationTier":1,"route":"pagerbridge"} => target=primary rotation next_attempt=...
WARN 2026-03-17T17:03:12Z pager-bridge resolve: expected field "escalation_level" missing => default suppress=true
```
Sara: ah — notify-service is sending `escalationTier` but downstream expects `escalation_level`. That rename got in during the deploy.
Ben: That explains suppression + duplicates: we have fallback policy that if primary ack pending we also send to secondary after 30s; because field mismatch, primary path dropped into suppress, fallback still triggered by older bridge logic — leads to duplicate pages.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0317-45 (paging-integration-schema-mismatch) — paging-rotation impacted.
Eli: Mitigation steps I started:
- manually triggered an immediate page to primary (confirmed delivered)
- set notify-service feature-flag `use_legacy_escalation_level=true` via /api/flags
- paused the deploy rollouts for notify-service and pagerbridge
Ben: Can you paste the flag toggle command you used?
Eli:
```
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"service":"notify-service","flag":"use_legacy_escalation_level","value":true}' -H "Authorization: Bearer XXXXX"
```
Max: Good call. I also restarted the pagerbridge consumer to pick up schema compatibility fallback. That reduced duplicates.
Lucy: Customer impact: Support ticket stream shows ~8 customers listed as receiving duplicate pages, 3 reported missing the first page (they acknowledged after manual). Escalation: Sev2 until confirmed all rotations healthy.
Sara: Root cause: schema rename slipped through without bridge compatibility. Pagerbridge expected `escalation_level` and treated unknown payload as suppress. Notify-service started emitting `escalationTier` in the deploy at 17:02.
Ben: Remediation: roll back the notify-service change (PR #789) and add a compatibility shim in pagerbridge to accept both fields. Also add integration test for payload variants.
Eli: Current status: primary rotation confirmed, manual pages verified, duplicates stopped after consumer restart. Monitoring: watch alerts for SUPPRESSED in notify logs for next 60m.
ops-bot: Pagerbridge consumer restarted by Max at 17:12:34Z.
Sara: Immediate owners: Ben (pagerbridge fix) + Max (notify rollback). Postmortem: assign Sara as PM for write-up.
Max: I'll open rollback PR now and add the compatibility shim in the same branch to avoid double deploy churn. ETA 45m.
Ben: I'll add integration tests and a small schema validator to alert during deploys.
Lucy: I'll draft customer-facing blurb: apologize, explain we had tooling mismatch causing duplicate/missed pages, fix in progress.
Eli: Thanks everyone — will keep monitoring. If we see any new suppression events, ping @ops.
Sara: Closing thread when we have rollback merged and 60m of clean logs.
Max: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/notify/merge/803 — rollback + shim.
Sara: Great. Follow-up action items for postmortem: 1) deploy-time contract checks, 2) better rollout flag for schema changes, 3) runbook update: manual page procedure and duplicate alert triage.
Ben: noted.
Lucy: leaving a support note on affected tickets.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0317-45 moved to status=mitigated by Eli at 17:25:45Z.
Sara: Thanks — we'll re-evaluate after 60m clean window and then do the full postmortem. :white_check_mark:
